title: Attacks on Fuerteventura in 1740
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Attacks on Fuerteventura in 1740", at revision 1370105483, opens: "The 1740 attacks on the island of Fuerteventura, also known as the Battles of El Cuchillete and Tamasite, by English privateers took place within a month of one another, and were both put down with little trouble by the island's militia. They coincided with the Anglo-Spanish war of 1739. Privateering by the British was common during this conflict and the attacks on Fuerteventura in 1740 can be seen as an extension of this period of discord between Britain and Spain." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q22936135, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1740 two attacks by English privateers on the Canary island". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
